LangChain Framework

LangChain is an open source framework with a pre-built agent architecture and integrations for any model or tool — building agents that adapt as fast as the ecosystem evolves.

Create an Agent

LangChain allows you to build agents quickly. Here is a minimal example using Anthropic's Claude:

# pip install -qU langchain "langchain[anthropic]"

from langchain.agents import create_agent

def get_weather(city: str) -> str:
    """Get weather for a given city."""
    return f"It's always sunny in {city}!"

agent = create_agent(
    model="claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929",
    tools=[get_weather],
    system_prompt="You are a helpful assistant",
)

# Run the agent
agent.invoke(
    {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "what is the weather in sf"}]}
)

Core Benefits

Why choose LangChain? It provides a robust foundation for building agentic applications.

Standard Model Interface

Different providers have unique APIs. LangChain standardizes interactions so you can seamlessly swap providers and avoid lock-in.

Flexible Agents

Build a simple agent in under 10 lines of code, while retaining enough flexibility for complex context engineering.

Built on LangGraph

Take advantage of LangGraph’s durable execution, human-in-the-loop support, and persistence capabilities.

Debug with LangSmith

Gain deep visibility with visualization tools that trace execution paths, capture state transitions, and provide metrics.
